catalog_description: Records-class labels applied to documents under a content taxonomy, governing retention and handling.
Folders, libraries, and nested collections that organize documents into a hierarchy.
Version history for each document, tracking publication and revision lineage over time.
Delivery-performance benchmarks for a value stream: deployment frequency, lead time, change failure rate, and time to restore.
Records confirming that data protection officers completed required training, evidencing GDPR compliance.
Standard dimensions used to measure data quality, such as completeness, validity, timeliness, and accuracy.
Aggregated quality scores per data asset and time period, rolling up dimension scores with trend and direction.
Agreed data quality thresholds, such as maximum null rate, duplicate rate, and incident response time.
Risky driving events detected by telemetry, such as harsh braking, speeding, or distraction, with severity and location.
Per-driver scorecards summarizing safety and efficiency risk from behaviors like speeding, harsh braking, and idling.
Pre-employment drug tests and occupational health screenings, tracking the order, provider, result, and any adverse-finding review. Holds sensitive medical data subject to legal restrictions.
Requests to launch a dry-stacked vessel for use and return it to its rack, scheduled against forklift capacity.
Rack positions in a dry-stack storage building, with bay, level, and maximum vessel length and weight.
Payment failures, retries, and past-due warnings that drive the involuntary-churn and collections workflow.
Alerts that a traveler may face an emerging risk at their destination, tracked from raised through resolved during assistance.
Preventive or corrective maintenance tasks on industrial assets, covering trigger, labor, parts, downtime, and assigned crew through completion.
Definitions of pay types such as regular, overtime, bonus, and severance, with tax treatment and accounting rules. Foundation of the payroll calculation engine.
Litigation data requests with matter reference, scope, requested record types, production timeline, and chain of custody.
Definitions of editorial review and publishing workflows: named states, transitions, and which role owns each step.
Voluntary self-identification submitted by applicants for equal-employment reporting, stored separately from candidate records per regulation.
Management-system audits against safety and environmental standards, routing nonconformities and findings into corrective actions.
Safety inspections and observations conducted against a checklist, with findings routed into corrective actions.
Occupational risk assessments that score the likelihood and consequence of identified hazards and assign controls.
Records of safety and environmental training, competency, or certification completed by workers, mapped to the roles and regulations that require it.
Hours-of-service logs from electronic logging devices, recording driving, on-duty, off-duty, and sleeper-berth status changes for roadside inspection.
People to contact in an emergency for a worker, with priority order and relationship. Holds personal data on third parties.
Lookup coefficients that convert an activity, such as natural gas or electricity, into emissions. Versioned by effective date.
Recorded greenhouse gas emissions from a facility, activity, or supply-chain tier, in carbon-dioxide equivalents with timestamp and source.
Spouses, children, and other dependents of a worker, used by benefits administration for eligibility and beneficiary designation.
Per-employee portal accounts in the equity-administration system, giving each employee visibility into their equity grants.
Single resolved employee identity reconciled across HR, payroll, identity, and time-and-attendance sources.
Canonical records of people currently or formerly employed, carrying identity, employment metadata, and links to position, manager, and org unit.
Contractual terms of employment: contract type, start and end dates, jurisdiction, working hours, notice period, and references to the signed document.
Lifecycle events for an employee, such as hire, promotion, transfer, leave, comp change, and termination. The audit history of an employment.
Seller trainings tied to content or a launch, such as certifications, pitch practice, and onboarding modules.
Behavioral deviations on a device flagged by analytics, such as unexpected network egress or impossible-travel patterns, scored and triaged.
Quality-of-experience scores for a user, device, and app combination, covering latency, availability, error rate, and responsiveness.
Calculated driver scores, such as growth, recognition, and leadership, at a team, department, or segment level.
Formal engagement letters or proposals between a services firm and a client, covering scope, fees, retention, and e-signature evidence.
Computed rollups of activity intensity per account or contact, summarizing how engaged a buying group is over a period.
Employee engagement, pulse, and sentiment survey responses, used to score engagement and trigger interventions.
Parent-child line items in an engineering bill of materials, each linking one child part under a parent assembly with quantity and effectivity.
Engineering change orders capturing a proposed change, impact analysis, approval routing, effective date, and the affected parts, BOMs, and drawings.
The engineering item master: every distinct part, assembly, or component the organization recognizes, anchoring revisions, BOMs, and CAD files.
System, software, and hardware requirements with parent-child decomposition, verification method, allocated subsystem, and links to test cases.
Released revisions of an engineering part, each a frozen snapshot of attributes, BOM, and CAD references minted only by a change order.
Devices under mobile-device management, with enrollment identity, status, ownership type, assigned profile, and last sync.
Zero-touch provisioning credentials for device onboarding: token, QR code, validity window, assignment batch, and redemption count.
Business applications in the enterprise portfolio, with owner, criticality, lifecycle state, hosting model, and strategic value.
E-signature transactions wrapping one or more signature requests against a document, tracked from created through completed, declined, or voided.
Environmental monitoring samples for pathogen testing, with zone, site, sampling date, and lab result, aggregated into trend analytics.
Environmental permits for air, water, or waste, with their conditions, limits, monitoring obligations, and renewal schedule.
Preventive-maintenance templates per asset or asset class, defining the trigger basis, task list, frequency, and due-date rules that generate work orders.
Equity awards such as restricted stock units, options, and performance units, with grant terms, vesting schedule, and forfeiture rules.
Aggregated exception records grouped by fingerprint, with first and last seen, occurrence count, affected releases, owners, and status.
Policies that escalate overdue training through manager, skip-level, HR partner, or compliance officer.
Prepared sustainability disclosures per reporting framework for a fiscal year, combining narrative, metrics, and assurance status.
Action programs to cut emissions or improve social and governance outcomes, such as renewable projects or diversity hiring, tracking budget and impact.
Derived sustainability metrics, such as total emissions, intensity ratios, and water, waste, and governance indicators, refreshed each reporting cycle.
Sustainability commitment goals, such as net-zero or reduction targets, with target year, baseline, scope coverage, and progress against actuals.
Reusable quality scorecard definitions with sections, weighted items, scoring scale, and auto-fail criteria. Versioned so historical scores stay interpretable.
Clustered groups of events and alerts identified as a single underlying incident, with a candidate root cause for noise reduction.
Raw timestamped sequences of business-process events extracted from systems, the primary input for process discovery and conformance checking.
Heightened-monitoring assessments of departing employees, scoring exit-related data-theft risk and driving watchlist placement.
Hypothetical or committed exit scenarios for a company, with total deal value, structure, and terms that drive proceeds calculations.
Per-shareholder proceeds calculations under an exit scenario, respecting liquidation preferences, participation rights, and conversion economics.
Individual lines on an expense report: date, merchant, category, amount, tax, billable flag, and receipt. The atomic expense unit.
Configurable expense rules, such as per-diem caps, category limits, receipt requirements, and mileage rates, applied to flag violations.
Employee-submitted bundles of expense lines for a trip, project, or period, with submission status, approval chain, and reimbursement routing.
Court filings made on behalf of a law-firm client, with venue, judge, docket, and key dates.
Invitations granting external users or other workspaces federated access, with invitee, status, expiry, and scope.
Single structured values extracted from a document by a model, with field name, value, confidence, and model version. The unit for field-level validation.
Extracted fields grouped into a single business entity, such as an invoice or form, with record type, aggregate confidence, and status.
Emissions inventories at facility, plant, or building level, derived from metered utility data by scope and source.
Preventive or corrective maintenance tasks on buildings and workplace assets, such as HVAC, lighting, plumbing, and grounds.
Field and paddock boundaries with soil type, productivity zones, and crop history. The spatial unit of farm operations.
Branded farm e-commerce storefront configurations, including catalog scope, member pricing tiers, and gift-card setup.
On-site farmers-market transactions and reconciliation summaries, with line items and tender mix across cash, card, and benefits payments.
Legally required disclosure forms shown to a candidate before a consumer report is requested, with text version, signature, and timestamp.
Candidate acknowledgments of receiving the summary of consumer rights at consent time, captured separately so the copy and timestamp persist for audit.
Tamper-evident, retention-locked audit-trail rows for regulated training, meeting electronic-records requirements.
Customer requests for new capabilities, feeding the product prioritization workflow.
Versioned feature-store entries with feature definitions, serving configuration, freshness targets, and lineage to source tables.
Per-group total mixed ration formulations, listing ingredients, inclusion percentages, and mixing logs for feed-cost analysis.
Continuous feedback such as kudos, one-on-one notes, requested feedback, and peer comments, independent of formal review cycles.
Per-pass chemical, fertilizer, or micronutrient application events, with product, rate, applicator, and restricted-use justification.
Scheduled or completed on-site visits by a field technician, capturing arrival, work performed, parts used, customer signature, and outcome.
Approved annual or quarterly budgets by org unit, cost center, account, and period, driving downstream spend authorization.
Rolling forecasts that refresh the expected revenue, cost, and headcount view given current actuals, distinct from the static budget.
Umbrella records for financial planning artifacts: annual budget, rolling forecast, and long-range plan, with period, version, and approval state.
What-if financial models layered on a base plan, such as revenue upside, downside, cost-cutting, and acquisition scenarios.
Continuing-education ledger rows per registered representative, retained as regulator evidence.
Computed match scores between a person and a role or opportunity, with score, model version, and drivers.
Capitalized property, plant, and equipment records, with acquisition date, cost basis, useful life, depreciation method, and location.
Time-bound assignments of a vehicle to a driver, route, or job, with start and end time, purpose, and expected mileage.
People authorized to operate fleet vehicles, with license class and expiration, medical card status, certifications, and employment type.
Fleet vehicle master records, with identification, make, model, registration, fuel type, in-service date, and lifecycle status.
Floor layouts showing desk and room locations, capacity, and zone assignments.
